title: Maricha's counsel
disclaimer: Two-hander. Ravana face matches ep04. Golden-deer plan labeled dramatized-as-traditional where needed; the plan itself is supported.
story_goal: Ravana recruits Maricha; golden-deer plan; Maricha's fear.
framework_goal: Two-hander intrigue; Ravana consistency from ep 4.
gate: Maricha bible; plan fact-checked as dramatized Valmiki beat.
narrative_summary: Maricha says do not. Ravana says you will. The deer is named.

fact_checks.claim: Maricha is coerced into becoming the golden deer.
fact_checks.source_note: Aranya Kanda counsel scene; dialogue dramatized.

panels.scene_description: Maricha thinner, older, already afraid before the order.
panels.caption: He has seen that bow.

panels.scene_description: Ravana king form from ep04. Same primary face.
panels.dialogue: RAVANA: You will be a deer. Gold. Too beautiful for a forest.

shot_card.camera: two-shot, Ravana standing, Maricha seated or kneeling

panels.dialogue: MARICHA: I have died at his hand in other shapes. Do not send me to die as a toy.

panels.scene_description: The plan in two sentences: deer, cry, empty hut.
panels.dialogue: RAVANA: She will send the husband. Then the brother. Then I walk in.

shot_card.camera: overhead or wide of the two, like a map
shot_card.lighting: flat-ish, diagram feel without breaking style

panels.scene_description: He agrees with his whole body against it.
panels.dialogue: MARICHA: When I cry, it will be his voice. Remember I warned you.

panels.scene_description: Alone again. Ascetic kit not yet on — king still.
panels.caption: He will change clothes. Not the face.

panels.scene_description: Hint of gold at the edge of the frame — not full deer yet.
panels.caption: Tomorrow the forest will want something that does not belong there.

shot_card.camera: detail, gold light on a hand or eye
shot_card.blocking: transformation implied, not CGI morph porn
